messages.text: is there a setting to turn the display off on the GekkoScience KBOX

The listing doesn't spell that out, so I don't want to guess. What it does say: the KBOX has user-controllable RGB LED modes with a remote, and its live stats display sits in the web config, so both are software-side rather than fixed. Whether there's a full off setting for the LEDs or the screen I'd have to confirm with the team.

Do you want me to check, and is it the RGB lighting or the stats screen you're trying to kill?
